context: Sho and Hina watch birds in the morning.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、鳥、いっぱい、いる！
lines.en: Sho, look — there are so many birds!
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Quick breath before the reveal. Open vowels, genuine childish wonder. Slight rise at 'birds' — not a question, pure discovery shared.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small, genuine agreement. Soft voice, thoughtful pace. A six-year-old noticing beauty without needing to perform it. Warm acceptance.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Same bright energy as before but more focused now. Narrowing her observation down. Quick, clear delivery. The joy of noticing detail.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Not answering — sharing an inner thought out loud. Slow, steady pace. The voice of a child who watches more than he speaks.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Should we give them some bread?
lines.style: Idea arriving mid-moment. Slight lift on 'bread' — seeking partnership, not permission. Eager but checking: 'Is this okay with you?' Childish generosity.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Let's do it together — gently, okay?
lines.style: Soft instruction from a small boy. Protective of the birds and of the moment. Deliberate pace on 'gently.' The voice of care, not complaint.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Simple, closing observation. Warm exhale. The whole moment settling into his awareness. Quiet satisfaction. Brief pause before the period.
